description: This Java source file defines the CacheFilter class, which implements a servlet Filter to process HTTP requests, primarily to prevent a specific security issue in OFBiz by manipulating request URIs.

classes.name: CacheFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that processes HTTP requests to modify or examine request URIs, mainly to address security concerns in OFBiz.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each request by extracting the URI without the context path and passing the request and response along the filter chain.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the filter is taken out of service.
